seed_text: Kestrel Valley Hospital has opened a new stroke unit in Tamworth, health officials said on Tuesday. The unit will treat about 2,300 patients a year. Chief executive Ruth Ellery said the opening would cut average waiting times to 18 days. The building cost 14m pounds and was funded by the Westmoor Health Trust. The first patients were admitted in March.
